searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md, life/PROFILE.md, life/OUTLOOK.md §5, morning-briefing/profile.md, data/target-companies.json, history/sent-log.json (last ~190 opportunity entries), and data/applications.json. Note: the graduation-date conflict described in this run's instructions is already resolved in the files — life/PROFILE.md states December 2026 'SETTLED by Dom 2026-08-04', matching morning-briefing/profile.md; nothing to reconcile. Network check before hunting: WebFetch returned ENOTFOUND for every job-board/company host attempted — job-boards.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com, www.ycombinator.com, www.metacareers.com, www.nvidia.com, www.databricks.com — while only anthropic.com resolved. This is the third consecutive run with this exact failure pattern (matches 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25 logs), so it is a session/environment network-policy block, not a transient outage. WebSearch (a separate mechanism) works normally. With WebFetch blocked for every target-companies.json board, the only verifiable source was anthropic.com/careers/jobs directly: 634 roles across 20 teams, confirmed via direct fetch. Checked the Sales team (123 roles) specifically for Business Development Representative / early-career titles — found one 'Business Development Representative' (SF/NYC) that is title-ambiguous against an already-sent 'Business Development Representative, New York' entry in sent-log history, so not safe to surface as new. Checked Applied AI family: all Applied AI Architect variants require 3-8+ years customer-facing experience (dealbreaker per profile.md), confirming target-companies.json's existing note that Anthropic has no new-grad pipeline and the Fellows Program is research-only. No other target-companies.json board, program site, or fellowship could be fetched to verify eligibility/open-status, so per the standing rule (verify by fetching the real page, never include on a search snippet alone) nothing is included. Zero verified opportunities is the honest result for the third straight day; the recurring cause is the network block, not an absence of real postings.
